text:
Ava: Heads-up — Orion pilot just confirmed: private deploy + HSM required, target go-live Apr 15. Need cross-team sequencing for launch criteria (latency SLO, canary, rollback).
Sam: Are we locking model size/quantization yet? that impacts RAM and batch sizing.
Ravi: Not locked. recommend 4-bit quant for cost but need perf validation on our runtime for 512->1024 tokens. I'll run perf matrix this week. @Leah we need reserved GPUs for the test harness.
Leah: Can provision a small reserved pool in us-west-2 for canary (2xA100). Need ticket with expected hours + prewarm window.
Noah: Security: HSM attestation + key rotation policy required. ETA for review ~5 business days if we get docs today. Also need threat model sign-off for private control plane.
Marta: Observability: we need token-level cost traces and latency histograms for the canary. I'll add a dashboard template and an alert (p99 > 300ms).
Ava: Proposal: three scope choices — A) full HSM + canary (Apr 15), B) HSM deferred, hosted fallback (Apr 8), C) pilot in hosted only (no HSM). Which is realistic?
Sam: A is tight. B seems safer unless runtime perf tests finish by Tue.
Ravi: I can deliver perf numbers by Tue EOD. If 4-bit meets p95 120ms then A is viable. If not, fallback to B.
Leah: To support A we need infra ticket with: GPU hours, network ACLs, private subnet details, and HSM endpoint. I'll create it now.
Noah: I'll prioritize the HSM attestation doc review once Leah shares endpoint details — ping me @Noah when it's in the ticket.
Ava: OK action items: (1) Ravi — perf matrix (4-bit / 8-bit) by Tue EOD; (2) Leah — infra ticket w/ resource estimate today; (3) Noah — security review on receipt (5 business days); (4) Marta — dashboard + alert before canary.
Sam: Adding runtime checklist for canary: model pinning, KV cache warm, continuous batching config, and fallback route to hosted variant.
Ravi: Canary config I propose:
```
canary:
  percent: 10
  region: us-west-2
  model_version: orion-v1
  fallback: hosted-orion-v1
```
Leah: I'll wire up networking and allocate the GPUs for a 72h prewarm window. Will note cost in the ticket.
Marta: I'll create the dashboard and attach a runbook snippet for rollback triggers (token error rate > 1% or p99 > 400ms).
Ava: Decision rule: If Ravi's perf shows p95 <= 140ms with 4-bit and infra confirms prewarm, we go with A. Otherwise we run B and schedule HSM for next sprint.
Sam: Sounds good. Who's owning the canary on the day-of?
Leah: I'll own infra rollout, Ravi will own runtime rollout, Marta will watch observability, Noah will be on call for security.
Ava: Great — I'll update the roadmap item and ping partnerships for customer communication. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
